name: find_tx_by_amount
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Find Transactions page, select the given account in the Account dropdown, enter the amount in the Amount field, click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button in the amount section, and read the whole Transaction Results table into an output named transactions

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Find Transactions page, select the given account in the Account dropdown, enter the amount in the Amount field, click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button in the amount section, and read the whole Transaction Results table into an output named transactions

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 with username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Find Transactions page
steps.action: Locate and click the 'Find Transactions' link in the navigation/sidebar menu

steps.intent: Select the given account in the Account dropdown
steps.action: Find the Account dropdown on the Find Transactions page and select the option matching account_id

steps.intent: Enter the amount in the Amount field within the amount search section
steps.action: Locate the Amount input field in the amount search section and type the value of amount

steps.intent: Click the FIND TRANSACTIONS button associated with the amount section
steps.action: Click the 'Find Transactions' button that is in the amount search section to submit the query

steps.intent: Read the entire Transaction Results table into the output named transactions
steps.action: Capture all rows and columns of the Transaction Results table that appears after the search
